actions.name: OpenADMXFolderToolStripMenuItem_Click
actions.purpose: Asks for a folder of policy definitions and loads it into the workspace.

context.scope: Action started by a person in the Main screen of Browsing policy definitions: Asks for a folder of policy definitions and loads it into the workspace.
rules: When a language file has no policy resources section, or its revision is missing or not a number, the file is refused as invalid and its template file is not loaded. (PolicyPlus/AdmlFile.vb:18)

A template file is refused as invalid when any of these is missing or unreadable: the policy definitions section; a namespace entry's prefix or namespace; a superseded-ADM file name; a minimum revision (missing or not a number); a support rule's name or display name; a support reference or range without its reference, or a version bound that is not a whole number; a product's name, display name or version index; a category's name or display name; a category's parent entry or its reference when the category has content; a policy's name, display name, key or class; a policy's category or supported-on reference; a number value's value; a list item's value name; a choice item's display name; or an option's id. (PolicyPlus/AdmxFile.vb:20)
The namespace of a template is the one listed as its target; each prefix a template declares must be unique, and a repeated prefix refuses the file as invalid. (PolicyPlus/AdmxFile.vb:24)

A language file's text table is read only from its first text table, and each text is kept under its id; when the same text id appears twice, the file is refused as invalid and its template file is not loaded. (PolicyPlus/AdmlFile.vb:29)

A template's superseded-ADM file name and minimum language revision are read when present; a superseded entry without a file name, or a minimum revision that is missing or not a number, refuses the template as invalid. (PolicyPlus/AdmxFile.vb:30)

When a template file cannot be parsed as XML, it is refused with the message "Couldn't load <path>: The ADMX XML couldn't be parsed: <detail>."; any other read problem is refused with "The ADMX is invalid: <detail>". (PolicyPlus/AdmxBundle.vb:37)

A language file's screen layouts are read only from its first presentation table; when the same layout id appears twice, the file is refused as invalid and its template file is not loaded. (PolicyPlus/AdmlFile.vb:40)

When a template file's namespace is already held by a template file loaded earlier, it is refused with "The <namespace> namespace is already owned by a different ADMX file", so the same file cannot be added twice. (PolicyPlus/AdmxBundle.vb:44)

actions.name: PolicyObjectContext_ItemClicked
actions.purpose: Opens the category, edit window, details or inspection window for the chosen object.

context.scope: Action started by a person in the Main screen of Browsing policy definitions: Opens the category, edit window, details or inspection window for the chosen object.
rules: The Semantic Policy fragment shows one section per area the policy applies to: the machine section reads the computer source and its comments, the user section reads the user source and its comments; an area the policy does not cover is left out. (PolicyPlus/InspectSpolFragment.vb:7)
The policy inspector shows a "Registry value" line for the policy only when the policy names a registry value. (PolicyPlus/InspectPolicyElements.vb:9)
The policy inspector shows a "Client extension" line for the policy only when the policy names a client extension. (PolicyPlus/InspectPolicyElements.vb:10)
The policy details window names the section a policy applies to: "User or computer" when it applies to both, "Computer" when machine-only, "User" when user-only. (PolicyPlus/DetailPolicy.vb:11)

A policy's lists of on-values and off-values count as enabled or disabled evidence for each value in them that is present, using the list's own key when it names one. (PolicyPlus/PolicyProcessing.vb:11)
